import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a categorical bar chart of top 5 brands by average price
top_brands = data.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().nlargest(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_brands.index, y=top_brands.values)
plt.title('Top 5 Brands by Average Price')
plt.xlabel('Brand')
plt.ylabel('Average Price ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram of megapixels
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data['megapixels'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_megapixels.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot of price vs weight
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='weight_grams', y='price_usd', data=data)
plt.title('Price vs Weight')
plt.xlabel('Weight (g)')
plt.ylabel('Price ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_price_weight.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a count plot of sensor types
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='sensor_type', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Sensor Types')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_sensor_type.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
